gates.citation: Horsak B, Slijepcevic D, Raberger AM, Schwab C, Worisch M, Zeppelzauer M (2020), Sci Data 7:143 (GaitRec, figshare collection 4788012, CC-BY 4.0); vertical GRF (F_V_PRO), healthy controls vs knee-pathology cohort.

reference.citation: Horsak B, Slijepcevic D, Raberger AM, Schwab C, Worisch M, Zeppelzauer M (2020), Sci Data 7:143 (GaitRec, figshare collection 4788012, CC-BY 4.0); vertical GRF (F_V_PRO), healthy controls vs knee-pathology cohort.
reference.description: cohort contrast of stance-phase vertical-GRF landmarks between GaitRec healthy controls and the knee-pathology group reproduces the knee-pathology signature -- control loading peak 1.10 BW vs patient 1.02 BW, control mid-stance trough 0.75 BW vs patient 0.84 BW -- with a large first-peak effect size (d=1.33), on 208 vs 499 subjects
